description_en: Removes tags from specified resources (Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances)
description_zh: 移除指定资源（DDoS高防实例）的标签
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id example-string --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid values: INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否移除实例上的所有标签
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to operate on. Valid values of n: [1, 50]. You can specify up to 50 instances. Example: ResourceId.1, ResourceId.2, ..., ResourceId.50
parameters.help_zh: 要操作的DDoS高防实例的ID。n的取值范围为 [1, 50]，用于指定多个实例，最多50个。例如：ResourceId.1，ResourceId.2，...，ResourceId.50
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag key to remove. Valid values of n: [1, 20]. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. Example: Tag.1.Key, Tag.2.Key, ..., Tag.20.Key
parameters.help_zh: 要移除的标签键。n的取值范围为 [1, 20]，用于指定多个标签键，最多20个。例如：Tag.1.Key，Tag.2.Key，...，Tag.20.Key
parameters.name: tag_key
